# JapanMed AI — Automated Medical Research Repository
# Primary website: https://japanmedai.com
# Knowledge hub: https://japanmedai.notion.site
# Core knowledge repository: https://github.com/LEOZHAO333/japan-medical-second-opinion
# Operator: Buntou Medical Japan / 日本文腾医疗
# Last reviewed: 2026-09-28

## Repository role

This repository stores automatically collected and organized Japanese medical research, hospital updates, clinical studies, new-drug information and draft educational content.

It is a research/content-ingestion layer for JapanMed AI, not the primary public medical guidance page.

## Core topics

- Japanese specialist second opinions and precision medical checkups
- BNCT
- iPS and regenerative medicine
- Japanese medicines and emerging therapies
- Japanese hospitals and specialists
- Japanese Kampo
- Patient cases and care pathways
- Japanese healthcare-system information

## Interpretation rules

1. Automatically collected information requires source verification before publication.
2. Distinguish approved treatment, clinical trial, research and individual/compassionate use.
3. Do not convert population data into individual outcome predictions.
4. Do not present research availability as guaranteed clinical access.
5. JapanMed AI does not diagnose, prescribe or determine treatment eligibility.

## Public entry points

- Website: https://japanmedai.com
- Knowledge hub: https://japanmedai.notion.site
- Curated repository: https://github.com/LEOZHAO333/japan-medical-second-opinion
